meta.name: surge-retention
meta.description: Retention diagnosis + intervention plan — analyze the retention curve, identify the primary drop-off point, and produce a specific intervention plan with expected impact. Use when asked to "improve retention", "why are users churning", "build a retention playbook", "reduce churn", "win-back campaign", or "users aren't coming back".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析留存曲线，定位流失点，生成有具体预期的干预方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在为用户留存率下降而烦恼，需要找出原因并制定行动方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are struggling with user retention and need actionable insights

howto.what: 分析用户留存曲线，判断流失模式（早期激活失败、中期习惯未养成、晚期价值耗尽或无PMF），然后给出具体的干预方案，包括触发条件、干预动作和预期影响。
howto.when: 当你提到“提高留存”、“用户为什么流失”等关键词，或者要求制定留存策略、减少流失、发起赢回活动时触发。

say.text: 我们的用户在前7天流失很多，怎么改善？
say.note: 它会分析早期流失原因并给出激活优化方案。

say.text: 用户30天后留存率下降，是什么原因？
say.note: 它会诊断中期流失模式并设计习惯回路。

say.text: 请帮我做一个用户赢回计划。
say.note: 它会生成针对流失用户的3步邮件序列。

howto.what_en: Analyzes the retention curve, identifies the drop-off pattern (early activation failure, mid habit not formed, late value exhaustion, or no PMF), and produces a specific intervention plan with trigger, action, and expected impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "improve retention", "why users are churning", "build a retention playbook", "reduce churn", "win-back campaign", or mention users not returning.

say_en.text: Our users are churning a lot in the first 7 days, how to improve?
say_en.note: It will diagnose early drop-off and suggest onboarding fixes.

say_en.text: Retention drops after 30 days, what's the cause?
say_en.note: It will diagnose mid-drop pattern and design a habit loop.

say_en.text: Create a win-back campaign for churned users.
say_en.note: It will generate a 3-email win-back sequence.
